title: An investor reaches out and asks whether the founder is raising

objects.subject: Nimbus Labs
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

I came across Nimbus Labs in a founder community. We invest in AI-native productivity at seed. Are you raising this year? Happy to grab 20 minutes.

Tom Keller
Partner, Northfield Ventures

questions.text: Is Nimbus Labs raising this year?

implied_actions: tell Tom whether Nimbus Labs is raising

not_expressible.workstream: STEP-11 — the file exists since STEP-09 (`GET /v1/workstreams`, its acceptance `tests/replays/test_every_piece_of_work_has_a_file.py`), but this line names its stage or state, and no stage is derived to compare against

answer.rationale: A direct question is waiting on us.
A person asked us for something; none of the support plays fits, and answering first is the closest.
A person asked us for something; none of the support plays fits, and answering first is the closest.
Defining the ideal customer profile does not answer what this person asked.
Someone at this company asked us something and the ball is in our court.
An investor asked us something; know the fund before replying.

facts.claim: Tom Keller, a partner at Northfield Ventures, wrote unprompted that he came across Nimbus Labs in a founder community and that Northfield invests in AI-native productivity at seed.
facts.quote: came across Nimbus Labs in a founder community. We invest in AI-native productivity

facts.claim: Tom asked whether Nimbus Labs is raising this year and offered a short call.
facts.quote: raising this year? Happy to grab 20 minutes. Tom

facts.claim: The file holds one open ask, Tom's question, waiting on us.
Our reply time to Tom is not measured: the file holds no mail from Arjun to him.
The file's history records no earlier verdict or outcome.

inferences.claim: An on-thesis partner offering a call unprompted is the warm end of first contact, and the honest answer to his question is yes: the brief says Nimbus Labs is raising its seed round.
Tom found the company on his own, so the seed-wave mail the brief mentions may not have reached him, or reached someone else at the fund.
The reply decides whether a first call happens while his interest is fresh.

patterns.claim: When the turn is ours, nobody says the clock is running; an unanswered inbound reads to the fund as a company without momentum.
Most first contacts with investors never become a meeting; an investor who offers the call himself is the exception.
Momentum comes from running investors in parallel; a new live fund belongs in the round's other conversations, not in a queue.
Warm interest is not an offer: only a definite offer in writing counts.

hypotheses.proposition: Tom will book a first call quickly if Arjun answers with times.
hypotheses.needs: A call on the calendar after the reply.

hypotheses.proposition: Northfield's interest is broad scouting of AI-native productivity that may stop at a first call.
hypotheses.needs: What Tom asks for after the first call.

unknowns.question: Whether the seed-wave mail the brief mentions reached anyone at Northfield, and what it said.
unknowns.relevance: If Tom has it, the reply can build on it; if it went to someone else, the reply should not assume he saw it.

unknowns.question: How much Arjun wants to say about the round's size and timing to a fund he has not met.
unknowns.relevance: It shapes how much the reply says beyond yes; the dossier holds none of it, and none should be guessed.

unknowns.question: Northfield's cheque size and portfolio.
unknowns.relevance: The playbook's call preparation needs them, and they decide how much of the round this fund could be.

frames.primary: A seed fund's partner, unprompted and on thesis, asks whether you are raising and offers a call; the answer is ours to give, and it is yes.
rivals: A scout's broad outreach to many AI-native companies, where the call is a screen rather than real interest.
A fund gathering market knowledge on AI-native productivity, with little intent to invest at this stage.

expected_vs_actual.expected: At first contact nothing has started; the stage ends when a first call takes place or the investor declines, and an investor's own offer of a call is taken up promptly.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Tom asked whether the company is raising and offered a short call; the file holds no answer from Arjun.

scenarios.do_nothing: Tom's question ages; a fund that reached out unprompted reads the quiet as no interest, and the conversation decays into a no nobody sends.
scenarios.act: A short yes with two or three times for a call turns inbound interest into a first meeting.
scenarios.best: A first call with an on-thesis partner leads to a partners' meeting and a place in the seed round.
scenarios.worst: The reply is slow or vague and Northfield moves on, or Arjun says more about the round than he means to a fund he has not met.
signals_to_watch: Tom booking one of the times offered
Questions from Tom before the call
Quiet from Tom after Arjun's answer
Tom saying the fund wants a lead investor first

reasons: Raising the seed round is the brief's first goal, and an on-thesis partner asked about it unprompted.
The reply is ours, and the playbook ages conversations where we owe the answer first.
A yes with times for a call commits Arjun to nothing he cannot shape on the call.

next_move.what: Reply to Tom that you are raising your seed round now, and offer two or three times for a short call

answer.alternative: If you want the call to wait until more of the round is in motion, reply now with a yes and the week you can talk, rather than leaving the question open.
answer.wait_or_stop: Do not wait to answer. After the reply, wait for Tom to pick a time; if he goes quiet, treat it as a first contact that did not take, and send no chase.
answer.done_when: A first call with Tom is on the calendar.
answer.draft: Hi Tom, thanks for reaching out. Yes — Nimbus Labs is raising its seed round now; we're building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'd be glad to talk. Would [two or three times] work for a short call? Arjun

notes: Production's AI filter called the real mail junk.
